instructions: Use the current Task workspace as the only project area: choose a new absolute checkout path below the current working directory, for example <cwd>/bbdev-checkout, and keep all edits, builds and run outputs below that path. Never use the shared baseline directly or create a checkout in a sibling/global runs directory. For direct bbdev operations, call mcp__buckyball__bbdev with project=<checkout> and a normal argv array such as ["bebop-bemu","--sim","--chip","poly","--core-index","2","--binary",<name>]. The server normalizes bbdev's operation arguments; Nix is already activated by this server. Use bash for source edits and other standalone tools, not to duplicate this bbdev entry.
